summary: Accepted after independent review: full original-image restoration matches every byte, followed by a matching original application boot after user-confirmed power cycling.
gate: A 4,194,304-byte backup with SHA-256 plus a recorded restoration boot; a backup alone does not close recovery proof.

summary: Accepted and archived after independent review: 600/600 CRC/count-valid snapshots, measured transfer timing and a 60-second 512-bin browser session. Known-signal RF validation is outside this accepted transport scope.
gate: At least 100 CRC-checked snapshots per advertised rate with failures and timestamps counted; 60 seconds of browser display with gaps documented.

summary: Five owned BLE packets prove narrow known-signal reception. Three-cycle RF repeatability, calibrated filtering/gain and extended tuning references remain open.
gate: Three repeatable source-on/source-off pairs with known center frequencies; each claimed extra tuning point has an independently known signal and uncertainty.

summary: Five complete owned BLE packets decode with exact known data and protected-PDU CRC. Counted emissions and capture hit/miss reliability remain open.
gate: At least 100 deliberately emitted repeat events with ground-truth counts and capture hit rate; a decoding claim includes a complete waveform and verified payload.

summary: Pinned source review selects a bounded snapshot/SPI route and quantifies the USB/RAM limits. Actual Forgix revision, wiring and sustained transport remain physical gates.
gate: An inventory plus sustained payload, loss/backlog and timing measurements. 80 MS/s × 20 bits requires 200 MB/s before framing; lower-rate or spectral output alternatives get separate budgets.

summary: Deferred by user. AtomVM integration is excluded from the active hardware evaluation; this plan remains available for a future decision.
gate: A documented SRAM/linker budget and a bounded prototype that preserves CRC capture integrity and records VM latency over 100 capture/control cycles.

summary: Accepted after independent review: current-dipole FM/RDS, four V4 transport trials and ESP snapshot gaps ground the receiver roles. Shared-signal sensitivity is explicitly deferred without conversion/reference equipment.
gate: At least 60 seconds per V4 sample rate with lost-sample counts, plus measured ESP snapshot gaps. Each chosen application states the receiver, coverage, continuity and proof status.

summary: Two independently reviewed consecutive minutes pass with the exact Nix-built receiver and RAM-buffered Task workflow: 2,712 and 2,713 valid frames, strict duration/end checks and full-flash restoration. Three failures stay visible. Exact-commit deployment, the live browser and every exported source comparison pass.
gate: A successful 60-second real spectrum session with CRC/sequence/end totals, visible gaps, full original-flash readback and matching boot, independently reviewed.
